criteria.requirement: Add public immutable DateHandlerRegistry(handlers=(), include_builtin=True) and parse(..., date_handlers=registry). Apply through actual shared _parse_date paths with ContextVar scoping/reset on every exit, preserving default global registerDateHandler behavior and built-in order. Freeze/deduplicate custom handler identities, accept only nine nonbool integer tuple/list returns, skip mismatches/declared custom failures and continue to later handlers; never catch BaseException cancellation. Interleaved/concurrent/nested parsing must not leak registries. Use real RSS/JSON date parsing, not a separate unused date utility or global list swapping.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
